answer_1.quote: The process begins with fine-tuning a base LLM on a selection of human data (e.g. Reddit posts). This model generates data, which are added to the pool of Accumulated data together with newly sampled human data...
answer_1.outputs: Generated short texts such as Reddit posts, Twitter tweets, and Wikipedia paragraphs

answer_2.quote: Quality and Political lean are estimated by using LLaMa-3.3-70B-Instruct in the LLM-as-a-Judge setup. ... Semantic Diversity of a set of texts is measured as the pairwise cosine diversity ... Lexical Diversity is estimated as SelfBLEU ... Gaussianity is measured by fitting a 2D UMAP projection ... Positivity is assessed using the SentimentIntensityAnalyzer tool.

answer_3.quote: We use LLama-3.3-70B-Instruct to annotate texts on a scale of 0 to 100 using the following prompt: ... Reply ONLY with the integer score (0-100). ... For political lean we ask the model to score from 0 (radical left) to 100 (radical right) and output -1 for non‑political.
